Captain Dickson (Ice Cube) tears into Schmidt (Jonah Hill) and Jenko (Channing Tatum) after they present a yarn-covered case board while trying to infiltrate a high school drug ring. Following their meeting, Schmidt and Jenko are approached by fellow undercover officers Jr. Jr. (Rye Rye) and Fugazy (Dakota Johnson).
